navigate_page_goto: navigate a web page to a URL with navigation timeout and waitUntil state control
test_page_click: test clicking an element by selector with modifiers, position, delay, button, and clickCount options
build_locator_query: build a locator query using get_by_role with aria role, name, checked, and disabled filters
capture_page_screenshot: capture a full-page screenshot as PNG or JPEG with optional path, clip, mask, and animation control
wait_page_response: wait for a page response matching a URL pattern or predicate with timeout and logging
